worked.title: Count at four stages
worked.scenario: A diploid cell has 2n = 6. Count chromosomes before replication, after replication, during whole-cell mitotic anaphase and in each daughter cell.
steps: After S: 6 chromosomes with 12 chromatids; DNA amount is doubled.
Anaphase before cytokinesis: 12 separated chromosomes in the whole cell, with 6 moving to each pole.
The chromosome count per daughter remains 2n = 6; specify boundaries when reporting the temporary anaphase count.
worked.label: Worked example

items.prompt: For 2n = 10, how many chromatids are present after S phase before separation?
items.explanation: Ten replicated chromosomes each have two chromatids.
items.cue: Multiply chromosome count by two only for the chromatid count at this stage.
items.hint: Multiply chromosome count by two only for the chromatid count at this stage.

items.prompt: A 2n = 4 model is in mitotic anaphase. How many chromosomes are moving toward one pole?
items.explanation: Each pole receives one full diploid set for the future daughter nucleus.
items.cue: The question asks about one pole, not the whole cell.
items.hint: The question asks about one pole, not the whole cell.

worked.title: Identify a stage without relying on the caption
worked.scenario: A model cell contains two groups of separated chromosomes moving toward opposite poles, and new nuclear envelopes have not formed.
steps: The chromosomes are no longer lined up at the equator, so this is not metaphase.
Sister chromatids have separated and are moving apart.
Count each separated chromatid as a chromosome, and state whether counting one pole or the whole cell.

items.prompt: Replicated chromosomes line up individually across the equator. Which stage is shown?
items.explanation: Individual chromosome alignment at the equator identifies mitotic metaphase.
items.cue: Look at position before deciding from chromosome shape.
items.hint: Look at position before deciding from chromosome shape.

items.prompt: Which structures separate during normal mitotic anaphase?
items.explanation: Sister chromatids separate into individual chromosomes.
items.cue: Compare copied chromosomes with the two strands inside a DNA molecule.
options: The two strands of every DNA molecule
